summary: Defines an optional extension to the Message Session Relay Protocol (MSRP) called Connection Establishment for Media Anchoring (CEMA). It lets middleboxes anchor an MSRP connection without having to modify MSRP messages, which also allows secure end-to-end communication. It is a standards-track specification.

eli5.summary: Two friends pass messages through a helper in the middle. This trick lets the helper hold the line open without opening or changing the messages, so they stay private.

questions: how do middleboxes anchor msrp connections
msrp end to end security through middleboxes
